dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: The trailing edge exhibits a deep concavity characterized by a smooth parabolic curve extending from the posterior base to the apex.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Classified as rounded with a continuous pixel radius curvature between the leading and trailing edges.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Convex anterior margin with an approximate 55-degree incline relative to the visible horizontal body axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: The ratio of maximum visible base width to vertical height is approximately 1.3:1.

other_distinctive_markers: Uniform distribution of numerous small, circular white speckles/spots across the lateral surface of the fin and surrounding base area.
